luna_supply_observation_convention.method: Use the completed hourly cumulative mint/burn observation, then forward-fill; never expose within-hour future transactions.
luna_supply_observation_convention.evidence: Raw 2022-05-13 01:00 cumulative supply includes about 1.97 trillion LUNA delivered by swaps at 01:50--01:59. Same-hour gross mint explains hourly supply increments with log10 RMSE 0.0157 over May 11--13; shifting flows by +/-1 hour raises it to about 0.448. Both initialization and evaluation use the end-hour convention.

notes: Micro-aUST in epoch_state divided by 1e6. Transaction amounts are already whole tokens.
Group observations are deposit/withdraw events, not aUST transfers.
First epoch_state at 00:14 UTC is used at 00:15; no backwards fill.
Hourly LUNA cumulative supply is shifted to the end of its source bucket before alignment; the initial snapshot uses only a completed pre-start hour.
Full-window maximum wealth and realized loss are excluded from agent decisions.
Trading depth is not observed; it must be calibrated and tested for sensitivity.
Anchor transaction observations and initial-principal group survival are unknown after the complete transaction extract ends; these buckets are NaN, not zero flow or unchanged balances.

anchor_transaction_observation_coverage.bucket_convention: Right-end timestamp; preserve cumulative withdrawals before first target; censor after the last observed bucket.

group_observation_coverage.bucket_convention: Right-end timestamp; preserve cumulative withdrawals before first target; censor after the last observed bucket.
